report.intro: If the chords or any other AI-generated content are inappropriate, offensive or otherwise problematic, please report it. Reports help improve the app.
report.describePlaceholder: What is wrong with the generated content?

update.title: Updates

backup.title: Backup
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore data from the backup? All current songs and recordings will be replaced by the backup's contents.
backup.hint: The backup (.zip) contains your songs and voice recordings. An automatic backup of the database alone is also made when the app closes (last 10 kept).
